contract.grammar:
root ::= "<expr>" factor_6 "</expr>"
feature ::= "$close" | "$high" | "$low" | "$open" | "$return" | "$volume"
constant ::= "-2.0" | "-1.0" | "-0.5" | "-0.01" | "0.01" | "0.5" | "1.0" | "2.0"
window ::= "1" | "5" | "10" | "20" | "40" | "60" | "120" | "252"
unary_operator ::= "Abs" | "Log" | "Sign"
binary_operator ::= "Add" | "Div" | "Greater" | "Less" | "Mul" | "Sub"
rolling_operator ::= "Delta" | "EMA" | "Mad" | "Max" | "Mean" | "Med" | "Min" | "Ref" | "Std" | "Sum" | "TSRank" | "Var" | "WMA"
pair_rolling_operator ::= "Corr" | "Cov"
cross_sectional_operator ::= "CSRank" | "CSZScore"
factor_1 ::= feature
value_1 ::= factor_1 | constant
factor_2 ::= feature | unary_operator "(" factor_1 ")" | binary_operator "(" factor_1 "," value_1 ")" | binary_operator "(" constant "," factor_1 ")" | rolling_operator "(" factor_1 "," window ")" | pair_rolling_operator "(" factor_1 "," value_1 "," window ")" | pair_rolling_operator "(" constant "," factor_1 "," window ")" | cross_sectional_operator "(" factor_1 ")"
value_2 ::= factor_2 | constant
factor_3 ::= feature | unary_operator "(" factor_2 ")" | binary_operator "(" factor_2 "," value_2 ")" | binary_operator "(" constant "," factor_2 ")" | rolling_operator "(" factor_2 "," window ")" | pair_rolling_operator "(" factor_2 "," value_2 "," window ")" | pair_rolling_operator "(" constant "," factor_2 "," window ")" | cross_sectional_operator "(" factor_2 ")"
value_3 ::= factor_3 | constant
factor_4 ::= feature | unary_operator "(" factor_3 ")" | binary_operator "(" factor_3 "," value_3 ")" | binary_operator "(" constant "," factor_3 ")" | rolling_operator "(" factor_3 "," window ")" | pair_rolling_operator "(" factor_3 "," value_3 "," window ")" | pair_rolling_operator "(" constant "," factor_3 "," window ")" | cross_sectional_operator "(" factor_3 ")"
value_4 ::= factor_4 | constant
factor_5 ::= feature | unary_operator "(" factor_4 ")" | binary_operator "(" factor_4 "," value_4 ")" | binary_operator "(" constant "," factor_4 ")" | rolling_operator "(" factor_4 "," window ")" | pair_rolling_operator "(" factor_4 "," value_4 "," window ")" | pair_rolling_operator "(" constant "," factor_4 "," window ")" | cross_sectional_operator "(" factor_4 ")"
value_5 ::= factor_5 | constant
factor_6 ::= feature | unary_operator "(" factor_5 ")" | binary_operator "(" factor_5 "," value_5 ")" | binary_operator "(" constant "," factor_5 ")" | rolling_operator "(" factor_5 "," window ")" | pair_rolling_operator "(" factor_5 "," value_5 "," window ")" | pair_rolling_operator "(" constant "," factor_5 "," window ")" | cross_sectional_operator "(" factor_5 ")"
value_6 ::= factor_6 | constant
contract.sampling_protocol: one identical prompt, eight independent completions
contract.summary: canonical neutralized rolling RNIC; mean signed L1-normalized fold weights; train only
contract.summary_template:
Training rolling RNIC={rnic:+.4f}: weights fitted on earlier years, scored on later years.
w averages signed normalized fit coefficients across three folds; negative means inverse use. Coefficients are not factor importance.
contract.system: Propose one alpha factor. Return exactly one <expr>...</expr> block and no explanation.

summary_values: synthetic formatting fixture, not measured market performance
